document.title: Health apps and wearable devices
document.question:
More and more people use smartphone apps and wearable devices, such as fitness watches, to monitor their health. Some believe this helps people to lead healthier lives, while others think it creates new problems.

Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
